Stop on mass cytometry data, which this package does not process

Source: R/read-fcs.R
stop_if_mass_cytometry.Rd

A CyTOF file has no scatter, carries ion counts rather than fluorescence, and needs bead normalisation, a DNA-intercalator singlet gate and an arcsinh cofactor of 5 before analysis (Finck et al. 2013; Nowicka et al. 2017). None of that is implemented here, and the fluorescence path would run on it far enough to produce numbers before failing at the scatter gate. Recognised by FCS 3.2 $PnTYPE "Mass", by $CYT, or by channel names written as a metal isotope with the Di/Dd suffix the acquisition software uses.

Usage

stop_if_mass_cytometry(nm, desc, kw, label = "")

Arguments

nm, desc

$PnN and $PnS values.

kw

keyword list.

label

file name for the message.

Value

invisible(FALSE), or an error.
